.github/workflows/ci.yml:result:Require.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import sys
results = json.loads(os.environ['CI_JOB_RESULTS'])
profile = results['profile']['outputs'].get('profile')
full = {'rust', 'oci-registry', 'catalog', 'msrv', 'contracts', 'sdks'}
required = {'profile', 'docs'} | (full if profile == 'full' else set())
failures = [name for name in required if results[name]['result'] != 'success']
if profile not in {'docs', 'full'}:
    failures.append('unknown CI profile')
if profile == 'docs':
    failures.extend(name for name in full if results[name]['result'] != 'skipped')
print('Selected profile:', profile)
print('Job results:', {name: value['result'] for name, value in results.items()})
if failures:
    print('CI did not satisfy its selected profile:', ', '.join(failures), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
PY
